scope: Primary-source research for seven selected development-task revisions
use_policy: Operational context and engineering semantics only. Fixtures, interfaces, fault combinations and expected outputs are authored. No raw source records, proprietary manufacturing data or third-party implementation code are redistributed.

sources.title: ERPNext workstation capacity validation fix
sources.observed: The merged change describes undercounted concurrent Job Cards when sequential classification leaked across time-log entries.
sources.adaptation: Weighted capacity calendars and earliest continuous booking across working periods and maintenance.
sources.limitation: The real patch was small. The benchmark's broader algorithm repair and exact booking contract are independently authored.

sources.title: ERPNext workstation documentation
sources.observed: Production capacity, working-hour shifts and holiday constraints interact in workstation scheduling.
sources.adaptation: A bounded absolute-minute calendar avoids timezone ambiguity while retaining overlapping reservations and closures.

sources.title: Process Mining: Conformance Checking
sources.observed: Local replay can give misleading conformance explanations; alignments seek an optimal correspondence between observations and modeled behavior.
sources.adaptation: Globally optimal deviation diagnosis with an independently specified cost, length and witness ordering.

sources.title: PM4Py Petri-net alignment variants
sources.observed: Alignment implementations distinguish trace, model and synchronous move costs.
sources.adaptation: An authored bounded weighted net with observation groups and deterministic audit output.
sources.limitation: No PM4Py dependency or implementation is included. Observation groups are synthetic, not a claimed field of the production dataset.

sources.title: Production Analysis with Process Mining Technology
sources.observed: Production event records provide case, activity, resource, timestamp and quantity context.
sources.limitation: The source supplies production context, not repair patches or reported incidents.

sources.title: Connecting, Deploying, and Using the Smart Manufacturing Systems Test Bed
sources.observed: NIST describes equipment-data collection, curation and reuse with manufacturing protocols and integrated information systems.
sources.adaptation: Historical metrology, scoped telemetry services and durable factory-data publication.
sources.limitation: No defect is attributed to NIST, and no full standards-conformance claim is made.

sources.title: Condition monitoring of hydraulic systems
sources.observed: The hydraulic rig records multirate measurements, including pressure and flow across repeated cycles.
sources.adaptation: Exact joint-support analytics with synthetic clock offsets, quality barriers, calibration changes and late corrections.
sources.limitation: The rig is not a semiconductor fab. The original dataset does not supply these software faults or missing-data scenarios.

sources.title: Python asyncio: Coroutines and Tasks
sources.observed: Task cancellation, shielding and strong references affect asynchronous task lifetime.
sources.adaptation: Scoped invalidation and generation-aware ownership with multiple independently cancelling callers.

sources.title: OPC UA Services: Common Parameters
sources.observed: Request handles are interpreted in session context.
sources.adaptation: An independently authored plant/cell command-key namespace and transactional revision-aware outcome replay.
sources.limitation: The benchmark does not implement OPC UA, and its idempotency contract is an engineering extension.

sources.title: Transactional outbox pattern
sources.observed: Publication intent must commit with business state; relay delivery can repeat and order matters.
sources.adaptation: Real SQLite persistence, injected crash boundaries, lease fencing, gap handling and safe retention.
sources.limitation: The bounded command protocol, consumer projections and fault combinations are synthetic.

difficulty_hypothesis.medium: Several interacting rules in one bounded service operation
difficulty_hypothesis.hard: Algorithm reconstruction across a global state space, continuous signal boundaries or independently durable participants
difficulty_hypothesis.status: Author design hypothesis; evaluate with preserved development-only model trials
